itens.trecho: "Logan: Uma Jornada Emocionante e Brutal" Logan é simplesmente incrível. O que mais se destaca é como os personagens são humanizados e como suas relações são exploradas. Hugh Jackman está incrível como Wolverine, mostrando uma vulnerabilidade surpreendente que nunca vimos antes. A trama de Logan é cheia de momentos emocionantes.

I believe that I am about to disagree with quite a few people now. You see, I did not like this movie. Not that this came as much of a surprise to me. What I got was pretty much what I expected. From a technical point of view the movie is quite well done. Hugh Jackman and Patrick Stewart are doing good jobs as always. The action scenes are good.

The Last Cut Is The Deepest! Did we need another X-Men movie? In fact did we need another Wolverine movie? Well the result is there for all to see, with Logan not only showing itself to be undoubtedly the best Wolverine venture by far, but arguably the best X-Men picture as well.
